decisions.reason: The PETG thermoforming blank remains tightly aligned with the firm's core dental materials and thermoforming know-how, and several years of market presence should have strengthened its ability to refine and support the product commercially.

The UV-curing lacquer still fits the firm's materials competence and in-house development base, but its less central position in the portfolio makes it more exposed to rationalisation than the firm's core digital-workflow products.

The intraoral contrast spray supports the firm's strategic push into digital dental workflows, where its existing customer access and technical knowledge give it strong capacity to learn from use and improve the offering.

Custom hearing protection earmolds build on the firm's established earmold manufacturing skills and channel relationships, so they are likely to stay, although they remain somewhat more peripheral than the main dental business.
